note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; soldier, worker and alate castes are all described, the nymph is not. The maximum width of the soldier head capsule and the postclypeal width of the worker are not recorded because the figures are incomplete owing to OCR damage. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: head capsule yellow, slightly darker anteriorly; antennae and labrum pale yellow; mandibles reddish brown; body pale yellow. Head sparsely pilose, body densely pilose. Total body length 4.3–5.5 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, length to base of mandibles 1.28–1.67 mm; width more than half the length, width/length ratio 0.58–0.60. Fontanelle minute, situated at the anterior third. Antennae usually 13-segmented, occasionally 12-segmented; segment 3 smallest. Labrum subpentagonal, anterior margin acute-rounded, sides nearly parallel, length 0.17–0.20 mm, width 0.20–0.27 mm. Mandibles 0.75–0.92 mm long, from slightly more than half to two thirds of the head length; coarsely serrate, with a larger tooth-like process slightly behind the middle; anterior part weakly to distinctly incurved, mandible length/head length ratio 0.58–0.66. Postmentum clavate, waist situated posteriorly, length 0.72–0.90 mm, maximum width 0.29–0.31 mm, waist width 0.16–0.17 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.22–0.33 mm, width 0.47–0.60 mm; anterior margin with a weak emargination, posterior margin slightly concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: head capsule pale yellow, remainder of body pale yellow. Pilosity of head and body rather dense. Total body length 3.8–4.5 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, length to base of mandibles 0.70–0.95 mm, maximum width 0.80–0.90 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus convex, pilose, length slightly more than half its width, its length 0.19–0.22 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.17–0.25 mm, width 0.39–0.57 mm; anterior margin without a distinct emargination, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Alate: head capsule brown to dark brown; postclypeus as dark as the head capsule; antennae brown; labrum and legs brownish yellow; pronotum and abdominal tergites and sternites paler than the head; wings pale smoky brown. Head and body densely pilose. Body length with wings 8.5–9.9 mm, without wings 4.0–6.2 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, length to base of mandibles 0.75–0.90 mm, width including compound eyes 0.77–0.90 mm; sides nearly parallel; with a V-shaped suture. Frontal plate subcircular, yellow. Compound eye subcircular, maximum diameter 0.18–0.24 mm, its distance to the lower margin of the head less than its radius. Ocellus oval, major axis 0.07–0.10 mm, minor axis 0.05–0.07 mm; distance to the compound eye about equal to its minor axis, i.e. 0.05–0.07 mm. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 longer than segment 3, or nearly equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus convex, pilose, length almost half its width. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, length 0.37–0.45 mm, width 0.56–0.72 mm; anterior margin straight, without a median emargination; posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Wings thin and transparent; fore wing 7.0–8.0 mm long, hind wing 6.7–7.7 mm long; anterior margin with 2–3 rows of short spine-like papillae, posterior margin with one row, membrane covered with non-stellate (5-armed) and stellate (5–6-armed) microtrichia.
